title: Advertise
description: This mod makes minecraft objectively worse with layers of ads.
body:
## Advertise.
Is a mod which adds the following:
![Minecraft Screen filled to the brim with stylised advertisements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d1663f675f88566bd13d3a252c027ca0fa2fe92.png)

It gets worse in the nether and **even worse** at the end of the game.
## The MISC:
- You can use /ad_rate to set the rate of the advertisements
- You can swat out advertisements out of the way with your mouse when your inventory
- Smile dog
- When you're paused, the ads fade out.
